meta.summary: A shop's tables: orders point at customers, order items at orders and products, each foreign key a crow's foot at its many side.

mkp-diagrams:cards@1.name: cards
mkp-diagrams:cards@1.about: Cards with a title and rows, and links between rows or between cards: a database schema, a class diagram, a map of services. Cards stand in columns by their links; pressing a row or a card lights its links and fades the rest.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: the header's title

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: what kind of thing it is, said small before the title: Schema, Classes, Services

inputs.name: caption
inputs.about: a line under the header, such as 4 tables · 3 foreign keys

inputs.name: cards
inputs.about: the cards: a title (the id when empty), an aside right of it (a stereotype, a technology), and rows, each with a label, badges after it (PK, FK, static) and a note at its right (a type); an external card is drawn dashed and muted

inputs.name: links
inputs.about: each end a card id (its title) or card.row; head is the mark at to and tail the mark at from: an arrow head, a hollow triangle (is a kind of), a bar (one), a crow's foot (many) or none

inputs.name: columns
inputs.about: card ids in columns, left to right, instead of laying them out by their links

inputs.name: lit
inputs.about: what starts lit: a card id or card.row

value.expr: map(cards, c => {id: c.id, title: if(c.title == "", c.id, c.title), aside: c.aside, external: c.external, rows: map(c.rows, r => {id: r.id, label: if(r.label == "", r.id, r.label), badges: r.badges, meta: r.meta})})
map(links, l => {from: l.from, to: l.to, head: l.head, tail: l.tail, label: l.label, tone: l.tone, line: l.line})

status.expr: cardsay(drawn, joins, pick, "Pick a row or a card to light its links.")

inputs.name: cards
inputs.about: the cards, each with its rows

inputs.name: links
inputs.about: each end a card id or card.row; head is the mark at to, tail at from

inputs.name: columns
inputs.about: card ids in columns, left to right, instead of by the links

inputs.about: what is lit: a card id, a card.row, or nothing

values.name: hops

value.expr: filter(map(good, l => {from: ends[l.from].card, to: ends[l.to].card}), e => e.from != e.to)

comment: card to card, for the columns: a link that closes a cycle doesn't count

value.expr: filter(ids, id => len(filter(hops, e => e.to == id)) == 0)
filter(hops, e => not (near[e.to] <= near[e.from] and levels(ids, [e.to], hops)[e.from] < 1000))

values.name: after
values.body: map(filter(onward, e => e.from == id), e => rank0[e.to])
comment: a card nothing links to sits just left of the nearest card it links to, so its links stay short

values.name: rankof
values.body: if(len(filter(onward, e => e.to == id)) == 0 and len(after(id)) > 0, max(min(after(id)) - 1, 0), rank0[id])

value.expr: filter(map(range(0, depth), k => filter(ids, id => rankof(id) == k)), col => len(col) > 0)
filter(map(columns, col => filter(col, id => has(byid, id))), col => len(col) > 0)

values.name: others

value.expr: fold(ids, {}, (d, id) => put(d, id, flatten(map(good, l => if(ends[l.from].card == id and ends[l.to].card != id, [ends[l.to]], if(ends[l.to].card == id and ends[l.from].card != id, [ends[l.from]], []))))))

comment: each card's other ends (on other cards); a card's weight is where they sit: their card's slot and
how far down that card the row is

values.name: slots
values.body: fold(cs, {}, (d, col) => fold(range(0, len(col) - 1), d, (d2, i) => put(d2, col[i], i)))

values.name: weight
values.body: if(len(others[id]) == 0, p[id], mean(map(others[id], e => p[e.card] + (max(0, e.n) + 1) / (len(byid[e.card].rows) + 2)))) + ix[id] / 100000

value.expr: if(len(given) > 0, given, iterate(bylinks, 4, cs => map(cs, col => sort(col, id => weight(slots(cs), id)))))
fold(range(0, len(cols) - 1), {}, (d, k) => fold(cols[k], d, (d2, id) => put(d2, id, k)))
filter(good, l => has(colof, ends[l.from].card) and has(colof, ends[l.to].card))

values.name: endmark
comment: where each link meets its cards: a row, or the card's title; a link whose mark differs from the
first one at that title meets the card's side instead, so two marks never sit on one point

values.name: claim
values.body: at(map(filter(shown, l => endat(l, side) == card), l => endmark(l, side)), 0, "")

values.name: el
values.body: if(ends[endat(l, side)].row != "", "r~" + endat(l, side), if(claim(endat(l, side), side) == endmark(l, side), "t~" + endat(l, side), "c~" + endat(l, side)))

values.name: span
values.body: if(colof[ends[l.to].card] > colof[ends[l.from].card] + 1, range(colof[ends[l.from].card] + 1, colof[ends[l.to].card] - 1), if(colof[ends[l.to].card] < colof[ends[l.from].card] - 1, reverse(range(colof[ends[l.to].card] + 1, colof[ends[l.from].card] - 1)), []))
comment: the elements a link passes on its way: the lane beside its column when both ends are in one, and
a channel at the foot of every column it skips

value.expr: map(range(0, len(shown) - 1), k => {k: k, l: shown[k], from: el(shown[k], "from"), to: el(shown[k], "to"), via: if(colof[ends[shown[k].from].card] == colof[ends[shown[k].to].card] and el(shown[k], "from") != el(shown[k], "to"), ["sl~" + colof[ends[shown[k].from].card] + "~" + k], map(span(shown[k]), c => "ch~" + c + "~" + k))})

inputs.name: fill
inputs.about: background

inputs.about: a wash of this colour behind it: a state, not a surface

inputs.about: the border's line

inputs.name: dim

core:text@1.name: text
core:text@1.about: A styled run of inline Markdown with inline maths.

inputs.name: lines
inputs.about: height kept for this many lines, so a shorter text moves nothing below it

inputs.name: literal
inputs.about: show the value as it is, not read as inline Markdown

inputs.name: caps
inputs.about: in spaced capitals: a caption or a label over a column

core:flex@1.name: flex
core:flex@1.about: Children in a row that wraps or scrolls.

inputs.name: line
inputs.about: the border's line

inputs.name: dim
inputs.about: faded back, while something else is in focus

inputs.name: blur
inputs.about: blurred past reading, until it is revealed

core:press@1.name: press
core:press@1.about: Anything clickable and focusable: a button, a tab, an option among others, an on/off toggle or switch, an answer row with a tick (check) or a dot (radio), or its content itself, such as a card (plain).

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: accessible name when the content has no text

inputs.name: emphasis
inputs.about: how much it stands out: low for one of a row of quiet buttons, high for the one to press

inputs.name: mark
inputs.about: an answer row's letter (A, B, C), shown in its tick or dot until it is chosen

core:icon@1.name: icon
core:icon@1.about: A symbol from a fixed set, drawn in the provider's own icon style.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: its colour; none: the text's

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: what it means, when it stands for words

core:zoom@1.name: zoom
core:zoom@1.about: A view the reader can zoom and pan once they unlock it, so scrolling the page past it is never caught by it. It starts locked; a try to zoom or pan then points at the lock.

inputs.name: max
inputs.about: how far it zooms in

inputs.name: fit
inputs.about: at rest, what is wider than the view is shrunk to fit it (never enlarged)

core:pane@1.name: pane
core:pane@1.about: A titled column of a stage: its title stays put while its body scrolls on its own. Panes side by side are divided by a rule.

inputs.name: note
inputs.about: right of the title: a count or a remark

core:frame@1.name: frame
core:frame@1.about: A widget's shell: what kind of thing it is and its title above a stage, and a bar of controls along the bottom. Nothing the reader does changes its size: what doesn't fit goes in its drawers or full screen.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: what kind of thing it is, said small before the title

inputs.name: height
inputs.about: the stage's height at rest (the reader can drag it); none: as tall as its content

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: one line in the bar: what is happening now

inputs.name: statuslines
inputs.about: how many lines the status keeps room for (1 to 3): a verdict with its reason

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: tints the bar: how an answer went (ok, bad) or a note (info)

inputs.name: actions
inputs.about: right of the title: the widget's own switches

inputs.name: bar
inputs.about: the bar: what is placed here, after the widget's own controls

inputs.name: about
inputs.about: a drawer: assumptions, and how to read it

inputs.name: details
inputs.about: a drawer: everything at once, such as the full table

**order_items**: order_id (PK, FK) `uuid`, product_id (PK, FK) `uuid`, qty `int`

**products**: id (PK) `uuid`, name `text`, price `numeric`

- order_items.order_id → orders.id
- order_items.product_id → products.id
